name: recall
description: Context you would otherwise retype: memory recall per prompt, smarter @-mentions, repeated-correction rules, a friction log and selection verbs

memoryServer.title: Memory server
memoryServer.description: Name of an MCP server (as /mcp lists it) to recall from on every typed prompt. Empty turns memory recall off.

recallArgs.title: Recall arguments
recallArgs.description: JSON object for the recall tool; "{{query}}" in any string is replaced by the prompt text.

maxChars.title: Memory size cap
maxChars.description: Characters of recalled memory added to a prompt.

smartMentions.title: Smart @-mentions
smartMentions.description: For an @file, add its last 5 commits, likely test files and files that reference it.

harvestCorrections.title: Correction harvester
harvestCorrections.description: Spot prompts that correct the assistant (a Haiku call per prompt) and offer a rule when the same correction repeats.

instructionsFile.title: Instructions file
instructionsFile.description: File a drafted rule is proposed as an edit to.

frictionFile.title: Friction file
frictionFile.description: Markdown file to append friction events to. Empty keeps them in the plugin store only.

retainServer.title: Retain server
retainServer.description: MCP server that /remember saves to. Empty stores notes in the plugin store.

retainArgs.title: Retain arguments
retainArgs.description: JSON object for the retain tool; "{{text}}" in any string is replaced by the selected text.
